topSignals.title: Fifth consecutive quiet day — Elcogen now 17 days quiet, Topsoe 84 days.
topSignals.text: Dedicated English-language searches for both priority stacks, this cycle's Tier 2 rotation round 2 (Ceres Power, Sunfire), the new Tier 3 rotation cycle 11 round 1 (Reverion, Convion, Hexis, Doosan Fuel Cell, SK ecoplant, Watt Fuel Cell), every standing sweep query, and broad AI-datacenter/hyperscaler (English and German), regulation, competing-power, market/financials, research/IP and scientific-paper checks all returned only recycled/already-logged background or out-of-window items (see notes below). Nothing beat or neared any row in SOFC_Benchmark_Records.md. For Dominic: no action needed on the LCOE model today; SPP's own FERC show-cause filing is due tomorrow (Nov 20) and is worth a dedicated check once it lands, since the other five ISOs' Nov 16 show-cause answers still have not produced analyzable trade-press content.

items.text: Elcogen (priority): 17 days quiet (since the Nov 2 Hygreen Energy MoU). No new item found today. Status unchanged: elcoStack E3000 G2 platform (75% FC electrical efficiency / 90% with heat recovery, 33 kWh/kg H2 SOEC — vendor claims) in volume production at the 360 MW/yr ELCO I Tallinn factory.

Topsoe (priority): 84 days quiet on SOFC/SOEC specifically (since the Aug 27 H1 2026 results/SOEC pathway reset). No new item found today; Topsoe's press feed remains active but non-solid-oxide (ammonia, SAF, blue-hydrogen).

Today's Tier 2 dedicated rotation (Ceres Power, Sunfire — round 2 of the current cycle): no new item for either; results recycled Ceres's standing Delta Electronics/Centrica/Weichai licensing background and a Nov 11-12 stock-move story already logged, and Sunfire's standing Schwarzheide SOEC test-facility/BASF background.
Tier 2 sweep ("Bloom Energy OR FuelCell Energy OR Ceres Power OR Sunfire OR SolydEra"): no new item; recycled standing Bloom/Brookfield and Bloom/Oracle background.

Today's Tier 3 rotation — new cycle 11, round 1 (Reverion, Convion, Hexis, Doosan Fuel Cell, SK ecoplant, Watt Fuel Cell), plus an OxEon Energy/Nexceris/Kawasaki Heavy Industries/Miura sweep: no new item for any; recycled the standing Doosan-Reverion SOFC stack-supply background, Convion's HD Hyundai ownership, Hexis's dormant post-Viessmann status, SK ecoplant's Singapore background, and Watt Fuel Cell's residential-only (non-data-center) product line.
Competitor roster: SOFC systems for data centers

Bloom Energy: Deployed/signed at multiple named sites — Oracle/Project Jupiter, AEP/Google Cheyenne Fuel Cell LLC (702 MW/$4B, 20-yr PPA), Brookfield EaaS, Nebius (328 MW/$2.6B), Equinix (>100 MW/19 sites), Aligned "Project Phoenix" (2 GW), Hitachi (Japan), SK Eternix (28 MW, operational), NTT DATA (900 MW, global, shipments from 2027).

FuelCell Energy (incl. HyAxiom-branded products): Signed orders/PPAs — Fit Energy (up to 380 MW), Inuverse Korea (up to 100 MW), Texas CRA (75 MW), SDCL (up to 450 MW). Also hosting the DOE/national-lab-backed StabilityMax R&D testbed in Danbury, CT. No named commercial deployment live yet.
Doosan Fuel Cell/HyAxiom: Signed order — US AI data center supply contract (KRW 823.6B); supplies SOFC stacks to Reverion. No named data-center site of its own yet.
Convion: Pipeline-only/pre-commercial under HD Hyundai ownership; no named data-center customer.
SK ecoplant: Pipeline-only; no named data-center deployment.
Ceres Power's SOFC licensees (Doosan, Delta Electronics, Weichai): Licensing/pipeline-only; no named data-center deployment via Ceres licensing directly.
Reverion: Pipeline-only — Doosan-supplied SOFC stacks for rSOC power plants (Germany); no named data-center customer yet.
Petra Power: Pre-commercial, no named customer; first infrastructure deployment targeted 2028.
EGEN Energy (China, watch-list): Pre-commercial/early-stage; no named data-center customer yet.
